notes:
Direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (no WAF, no Claude-specific robots.txt disallow). MAIN SITE: /clearance found in the mega-menu ('Clearance' with heavy sub-nav) and confirmed via Magento GraphQL categoryList (id 505, url_path 'clearance') with 11 real children -- genuine site-defined sub-structure, preserved as grouping row + leaves. All pages render via the same <category-view> component as ordinary categories (real product grids/filters), H1='Clearance'. Products load client-side via Searchspring (siteId zzw53h); used Playwright to capture live search.json totalResults and rendered 'N Products' text where possible. Confirmed a site-wide Searchspring +1-phantom-result offset (totalResults counts one extra result never actually returned) -- this matches the exact finding documented in the prior Home-Decor pass for this domain (16/16 categories then). This session independently re-verified it against live-rendered page text for: Clearance parent (232->'231 Products'), Clearance>Accessories (2->'1 Product'), Clearance>Sofas (19->'18 Products'), Clearance>Dining (44->'43 Products', exhaustive unique-result pagination across 2 pages = 35+8=43, exact match), Clearance>Further Reduced (123->'122 Products'). Applied the same -1 correction to the remaining children where only the API total was captured (Office Furniture, Bedroom, Mattress, Chair, Garden, Living Room). Clearance>Store Clearance child (clearance/store-clearance) returned Searchspring totalResults=0 with zero results -- dropped per the zero-product rule. 'Further Reduced' (a cross-cutting extra-discount tag applied on top of items also present in other clearance subcategories) is kept as its own genuine row per the brief's overlap-is-expected rule; children sum (446) exceeds parent total (231) because of this overlap, not an error. SALE VS CLEARANCE: found a generic /offers page (H1 'Discounts & Offers', NOT a Magento category -- categoryList returns empty for url_path 'offers') -- a promotional/CMS landing page with no permanence signal and no site-taxonomy Clearance label, correctly EXCLUDED per the Sale-vs-Clearance test. STORE CLEARANCE (main domain, /store-clearance, Magento category id 516, product_count=17): opened and rendered with Playwright -- NO Searchspring API call fires and NO product grid appears; the page is a marketing/landing page ('You'll find hundreds of fabulous discounted items in store... View items online') whose only action is a CTA linking out to a separate outlet microsite. EXCLUDED as non-PLP editorial/landing content despite being a real Magento category node. SEPARATE OUTLET MICROSITE: the main site's mega-menu also links (via 'Visit our dedicated outlet stores') and the /store-clearance CTA both point to https://www.barkerandstonehouseclearance.co.uk/ -- a genuinely distinct e-commerce platform (legacy PHP site, not Magento/Searchspring) dedicated to physical-store overstock/end-of-line/outlet furniture, i.e. squarely within the Clearance definition. Its nav exposes two orthogonal facet dimensions: (a) product category (Sofas & Chairs / Furniture / Bedroom / Garden / Accessories) and (b) location (12 named physical stores + 'Online'). Treated (a) as the genuine merchandising taxonomy (kept, with a server-rendered '<N> products' counter div directly confirmed in each page's HTML as literal, non-paginated evidence) and (b) as a store/location facet analogous to a store-locator filter (not enumerated as separate rows, including the 'Online' location) -- noted here as a deliberate scoping decision rather than silently dropped. No local-language variant needed (UK/English-only site).

[POLICY UPDATE 2026-09-11] Removed 6 Outlet-classified row(s) per corrected policy: Outlet is not Clearance.
